mapping.summary: No-code tool to add fields, features, APIs and design report layouts in BC.
claims: Adds fields to any table and places them on pages and reports
Links fields between tables and carries data between documents
Calculated fields with an expression editor
Builds new tables, pages and logic from templates
Publishes data and logic as APIs without code
Compiles changes into a standard, upgrade-safe extension
Visual drag-and-drop report designer with images, charts, QR codes, barcodes and MICR fonts
AI agent designs layouts from a description or a PDF or photo of an existing form
One style applied across quotes, orders, invoices, credit memos, reminders and statements
Layouts support grouping, subtotals, running totals, conditional sections and watermarks
PDF rendered inside BC with embedded fonts and optional encryption
Report designer is an optional paid edition
